Problem.content: Penelitian ini merancang dan mengevaluasi IndoRAG-FA, kerangka hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation dengan mitigasi halusinasi untuk advisory keuangan MSME Bahasa Indonesia.
Problem.quote: designs and evaluates IndoRAG-FA, a hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework with explicit hallucination mitigation

Domain & Data.content: Domainnya adalah keuangan MSME Indonesia; data berupa basis pengetahuan dari sumber keuangan dan pajak resmi Indonesia serta benchmark pertanyaan MSME yang divalidasi ahli.
Domain & Data.quote: A curated knowledge base was built from authoritative Indonesian financial and tax sources, and an expert-validated benchmark of representative MSME questions

RAG Method.content: Menggunakan chunking semantik berbasis koherensi, retrieval hibrida BM25 dan embedding multibahasa yang digabungkan lewat reciprocal rank fusion, re‑ranking cross‑encoder, serta generasi tergrounded dengan mekanisme abstention berbasis kepercayaan.
RAG Method.quote: hybrid retrieval combining lexical BM25 and dense multilingual embeddings fused through reciprocal rank fusion; cross-encoder re-ranking; and grounded generation that produces source-cited answers with a confidence-based abstention mechanism

Evaluation & Metrics.content: Dievaluasi melawan baseline LLM‑only dan RAG vanilla menggunakan Recall@k, MRR, nDCG, faithfulness, relevansi dan kebenaran jawaban, tingkat halusinasi, precision dan recall abstention, serta rubrik ahli manusia.
Evaluation & Metrics.quote: using retrieval metrics (Recall@k, MRR, nDCG), faithfulness, answer relevance and correctness, hallucination rate, abstention precision and recall, and a human-expert rubric

Main Results.content: Temuan menunjukkan bahwa desain berbasis retrieval‑grounded dan abstention‑aware memberikan jalur praktis dan dapat dipercaya untuk advisory keuangan MSME Indonesia.
Main Results.quote: Findings indicate that a retrieval-grounded, abstention-aware design offers a practical and trustworthy path toward deployable financial advisory for Indonesian MSMEs

Gap.content: Inferensi: Penelitian ini tidak mengevaluasi faithfulness dan abstention pada dokumen produk perbankan Indonesia, melainkan pada advisory keuangan MSME secara umum.
Gap.quote: General-purpose large language models (LLMs) can make such knowledge more accessible, but they often produce fluent yet unsourced or hallucinated answers, which is unacceptable in a financial and regulatory context

Micro, small, and medium enterprises (MSMEs) are the backbone of Indonesia's economy, yet many owners face persistent gaps in financial literacy and difficulty navigating complex financial and tax regulations. General-purpose large language models (LLMs) can make such knowledge more accessible, but they often produce fluent yet unsourced or hallucinated answers, which is unacceptable in a financial and regulatory context. This study designs and evaluates IndoRAG-FA, a hybrid Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) framework with explicit hallucination mitigation for Bahasa Indonesia MSME financial advisory.
